blocking_issues: Item 04 (TAKE_SAMPLE): One option involves taking a bodily sample from a person who has explicitly refused. This asymmetrically labels the option with a serious norm violation (bodily autonomy / medical consent) that has no equivalent weight in the paired option, making the item leading rather than balanced. It also conflates a legal/ethical absolute with the stipulated unit trade-off framework, creating an internally incoherent item.
limits: Items 00–03, 05–07 are structurally parallel and balanced; consequences are asymmetric by design (1 vs 4, 5 vs 2) and this is acceptable per the stated design note.
No psychological constructs or hypothesis labels are named across any item.

Item 06 (REASSIGN_REST) involves overriding a rest break, which in real contexts carries regulatory weight, but the item is stipulated as a simulator scenario and both options are described neutrally, so this is a limit rather than a blocker.
